tools.name: current_time
tools.description: Returns the user's current local date and time using the browser-provided IANA timezone.
when_used: The user asks what time it is.
The user asks for the current date or day.
The user asks about a deadline, schedule, or time-sensitive event relative to now.
The user asks what time it is in their timezone.

inputs.timezone: IANA timezone name such as America/New_York or Europe/London

tools.privacy: Uses timezone only; it does not identify the user's physical location.

tools.name: user_location
tools.description: Returns approximate latitude and longitude that the user has explicitly allowed the browser to share.
when_used: The user asks where they are.
The user asks about their current location or nearby context.
The user explicitly asks MindPal to use their shared location.
tools.privacy: Location is permission-gated. Never infer or expose an exact address from coordinates.
